# Data Goblin

> A free, public-interest field guide that teaches Canadians how to evaluate AI claims about power, data, infrastructure, and sovereignty — with a receipt behind every claim. Available in English and French.

## Guide
- [The Field Guide](https://datagoblin.ca/guide): the full guide, all chapters
- [Chapter 1 — What AI Actually Is](https://datagoblin.ca/chapter/1): start here
- [The Toolkit](https://datagoblin.ca/toolkit): test any AI claim with the bias-mapping method

## Reference
- [Receipts](https://datagoblin.ca/receipts): the claim-by-claim source ledger behind the guide
- [The Map](https://datagoblin.ca/map): browse the guide by region and question
- [Glossary](https://datagoblin.ca/loot): plain-language definitions of key terms
- [Updates & Corrections](https://datagoblin.ca/updates): dated log of changes

## About
- [About Data Goblin](https://datagoblin.ca/about): about the guide and Shadewater Labs
- [Contribute](https://datagoblin.ca/contribute): suggest a source or flag an error

## Editions
- [French edition](https://datagoblin.ca/fr): édition française (machine-translated, under review)
